text:
maria-sales: Hey team — Veridian Systems asked for a performance-run plan and a short pricing estimate. They want a POC that proves sustained throughput and tail latency for our chat endpoint. Key asks: sustained 250 qps, 10s bursts to 1k qps, ~1200 tokens per request, 95th < 300ms. They also want KMS/HSM assurance and a short note we can put in their security packet.

jake-eng: Ok. I can own the run. Can we confirm model size? sales said they want a Llama2-13B-compatible variant (quantized). Any constraints on private infra?

maria-sales: Veridian prefers private deployment (VPC) or Dedicated. They need SOC2 language and KMS in their packet — beth will help. Budget ask: they floated ~$10k/month committed but want to see cost projection for their workload.

leo-ml: For 13B quantized on our Dedicated hardware, rough ballpark: sustained 250 qps -> estimate ~4-6 GPUs (depends on batching). Burst to 1k for short windows needs burst pool or autoscale slots. I can run an initial sizing test: ramp to 300, 500, 1k.

jake-eng: Plan proposal (short):
- Stage A (smoke): 1k warmup single-client test, validate output correctness and token accounting.
- Stage B (sustained): 1h at 250 qps steady-state with representative payloads (avg 1.2k tokens). Collect p50/p95/p99, CPU/GPU util, mem, kv-cache hit rates.
- Stage C (burst): 3x 10s bursts to 1k qps, measure tail and drop rates.
- Stage D (failover): force one GPU OOM / node drain to validate fallback to N-1 capacity.

jake-eng: Quick runbook snippet to kick off smoke via API (use our hosted test harness):
```bash
# smoke request generator (single connection)
for i in {1..1000}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \ 
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \ 
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
    -d '{"model":"veridian-13b-q", "input":"<sample prompt>", "max_tokens":1200}' &
done
```
(We will run more sophisticated conductor for sustained load.)

beth-sec: FYI I need the following for their security packet: KMS provider (AWS KMS / customer-managed key), data retention policy, access control list for logs, whether inference traces contain PII, and which telemetry we share. I can draft answers if you send me the call flow and logs we collect.

maria-sales: They asked for an SLA sketch for Dedicated with 99.9% availability and burst guarantees. Also pricing table: hourly GPU price + token cost assumptions. Can someone create a 1-page estimate?

jake-eng: I'll produce an ops + runbook + observed metrics doc. For the 1-page estimate: assume 13B quantized DDR on A100/RTX-class — ballpark committed monthly for steady 250 qps with redundancy ~ $12k-$18k/mo depending on region and reserved vs burst. Will refine after we run Stage B.

perf-bot: baseline-results: 2025-09-04 10:12Z - internal microbench for 13B-q on rtx-a10x cluster (no KV cache):
- 250 qps sustained (synthetic smaller prompt): p50=85ms, p95=290ms, p99=480ms
- 500 qps (synthetic): p50=140ms, p95=420ms, p99=700ms
Notes: adding prefix caching and token-shave quant tuning usually cuts p99 by ~25%.

leo-ml: Good — that baseline aligns. For realistic 1.2k token requests p99 will shift up; we should run with their sample payloads. Jake, can you ask them for a 1000-sample payload set (anonymized)?

jake-eng: Sent a quick message to the Veridian contact for the sample set and a sanitized test API key. Also asked if they have an internal KMS CMK ARN we can point to for the Private deployment test.

maria-sales: Veridian replied: can share anonymized samples by EOD, and they can provide a CMK for the Dedicated POC but need a short runbook for how we use it.

beth-sec: I'll attach a standard KMS integration checklist and a brief HSM note. Also confirm: for logs we can redact inputs by default and only store aggregate telemetry. That should be acceptable to their compliance team.

jake-eng: Next steps (owners):
- jake-eng: schedule Stage A smoke this week and run Stage B early next week.
- leo-ml: prepare quant-tuning profile and caching knobs to test (prefix caching + KV retention 256k tokens).
- beth-sec: draft security packet answers and KMS checklist.
- maria-sales: collect budget/contract guidance from Veridian and confirm dates.

maria-sales: Acked, I'll push dates and loop in their security lead. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: ephemeral-note: I'll run a quick synthetic 250 qps 30m job tonight and post results to this thread when done.
